plugins.name: acl-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse Bash gate enforcing a project ACL. Vendored from clarity-auto-care.

plugins.name: no-shirk-hook
plugins.description: Stop hook that blocks the agent from ending a turn with an ask-instead-of-do question.

plugins.name: fs-acl-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse file-tool gate: a path-based ACL for Write/Edit/Read (the file-tool sibling of acl-hook).

plugins.name: branch-guard-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse file-tool gate: denies file edits (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) while a protected branch (main/master) is checked out.

plugins.name: review-panel
plugins.description: A panel of eight read-only reviewer subagents, dispatched by a PreToolUse hook over every commit of 64+ changed lines.

plugins.name: deep-investigation
plugins.description: Skill + three subagents that answer a why-question by enumerating every hypothesis first, then falsifying branches until one mechanism accounts for the whole effect.
